pillar.title: Escrow in Turkey: Legal Guide for Foreign Buyers

clusters.title: Escrow Agreement in Turkish Law: Clauses & Enforceability
clusters.gapNote: Competitors explain that escrow agreements are sui generis under the Turkish Code of Obligations but none provide a clause-by-clause drafting checklist with release mechanics, trustee liability, and dispute resolution pathways.

clusters.title: Who Can Act as Escrow Agent in Turkey? Lawyer, Bank, Notary
clusters.gapNote: Search results mention banks, lawyers, and notaries as possible escrow agents but no page clearly sets out who may lawfully act, licensing requirements, and the limits of each role under Turkish law.

clusters.title: Escrow for Real Estate in Turkey: Safe Payment Steps
clusters.primaryKeyword: escrow for real estate in Turkey
clusters.gapNote: Competitors describe simultaneous payment and title transfer at the Tapu Office but do not provide a step-by-step escrow-like payment workflow for foreign buyers, including bank blocked accounts and lawyer client accounts.

clusters.title: Escrow in Turkish M&A: SPA Clauses and Release Mechanics
clusters.gapNote: Existing articles cover escrow as collateral in share purchase agreements but lack practical guidance on aligning escrow release with SPA caps, baskets, warranty survival, and competition clearance timing.

clusters.title: Escrow Accounts Under Turkish Commercial Law
clusters.gapNote: Competitors note that escrow accounts are governed by the Turkish Commercial Code and banking regulations but do not explain account opening, AML/KYC obligations, or tax treatment in a single practical guide.

clusters.title: Turkey's Secure Payment System (Güvenli Ödeme) Explained
clusters.gapNote: Several competitors mention the new Secure Payment System and its postponement to October 1, 2026, but none provide a dedicated English guide covering scope, setup, and interaction with citizenship applications.

clusters.title: Lawyer Client Accounts in Turkey as Escrow Alternatives
clusters.gapNote: Competitors mention attorney client accounts and protection under the Attorney Law and Enforcement and Bankruptcy Law but do not explain how funds are held, released, or protected from seizure in detail.

clusters.title: Escrow for Off-Plan Property in Turkey: Buyer Protection
clusters.gapNote: Competitors warn about developer insolvency and recommend escrow, performance bonds, and completion guarantees but do not explain how staged escrow payments tied to construction milestones actually work in Turkey.

clusters.title: Escrow Costs and Taxes in Turkey: What to Expect
clusters.gapNote: Competitors mention escrow fees and taxes but rarely break down who pays, how fees are structured, and the tax/stamp implications in one place.

clusters.title: Is Escrow Enforceable in Turkey? Legal Framework
clusters.gapNote: Escrow agreements are described as sui generis under the Turkish Code of Obligations, but no page explains enforceability, remedies, and what happens on breach.

clusters.title: Escrow vs Earnest Money vs Deposit in Turkey
clusters.gapNote: Deposits, earnest money (kaparo), and escrow are often conflated; a clear comparison for Turkish transactions is missing.
